changes.comment: `dreamux uninstall` no longer recursively deletes `DREAMUX_ROOT` (config.json's directory, R26) wholesale. It now deletes the owned state/run/cache/log directories and config.json/config.toml individually, then removes the root itself only with a plain (non-recursive) rmdir, which fails and leaves the root in place when anything else is still in it. Previously, a custom `DREAMUX_ROOT` that held unrelated files or directories had all of them deleted along with the root; the default `~/.dreamux` root is unaffected when it holds only dreamux-owned files.
